Ara2 sir is very easy-going and one of the most humble faculty members. He teaches extremely well and practices many exercises in class related to each topic. He gives around 4 homework/ assignments, and quiz questions are usually taken from the homework. The midterm and final exam questions are of the same type as the practice problems.
Only the final exam includes some theory parts, such as a few MCQs and 2–3 proof-based questions. Students are required to answer only one proof question, and he informs the class in advance which proof will appear in the exam. He also gives clear suggestions about the exam pattern and often sets questions exactly as discussed.
The most important thing is to regularly practice the exercises done in class. He gives bonus marks to students who solve practice problems during class, although he does not announce it openly. He writes the names on a white paper at the end of the class.
attending all classes is essential if you do not want to miss out on bonus marks.

Last semester was his first at NSU, and he has a strong command of the course content. However, students often struggle to keep up during lectures, as he sometimes moves too quickly and does not always engage the class effectively.
The exam questions were relevant to the practice problems and assignments. Some questions were tricky but manageable for students who had a solid understanding of the concepts. He also awarded partial marks.
Lastly, he applied 10√x curve to our section; however, this was section-specific, as my friend did 323 with him in another section where no curving was applied.
If you can self study a little bit this course will be easy for you.
